video.title: 用这些来替代 yes，让你的口语更鲜活吧。#英语启蒙 #双语宝宝 #英语牛娃 #豆苗妈妈口语娃启蒙
video.scriptRefined:
Would you like to see a movie with me?  
Yes.

Do you want some popcorn?  
Yes.

How about getting a drink to go with our popcorn?  
Yes.

Excuse me? “Yes” is the only thing you could say?  
Use these alternatives instead. Let me show you.

Would you like to see a movie with me?  
Why not? Sounds like a great idea.

Do you want some popcorn?  
Yeppers. I have a sweet tooth, too.

How about getting a drink to go with our popcorn?  
Definitely. That would be great.

Do you get it now?
